sources.title: Fine-Tune LLaMA-8B for Medical AI on a 16GB GPU (Full Code Included)
sources.snippet: The full model stays in 4-bit, but the LoRA matrices are stored in FP16, ensuring stable training. Why QLoRA is Important ? Fig.Image from Fine-Tuning using LoRA and QLoRA — GeeksforGeeks You can fine-tune 1B, 3B, or 8B models on a single 16GB GPU. Training cost is extremely low, and performance is nearly as good as full-precision fine-tuning.
